column1: # Java reference registry: one row per pinned Closure Compiler reference (docs/PORTING.md §9).
# Read by scripts/paths.sh, scripts/paths.py and scripts/paths.mjs from their own checkout, so a
# branch decides its default; CLOSURE_RS_REF=<tag> selects another row. Tab-separated; paths are
# relative to ROOT (the main checkout). jar_sha256 is "-" until that reference jar is built and
# pinned. References live alongside each other: a new row never reuses another row's paths.
